title: Terms Glossary
description: Shared vocabulary glossary. Each question references entries by id via term_ids. Defined once here (DRY), never duplicated inside questions.

aliases.description: Other names for the same thing; also helps the answer-classifier interpret the learner.

pronunciation.description: Plain phonetic respelling a kid can read aloud, e.g. 'uh-MEND-ment' (CAPS = stressed syllable).

kid_definition.description: Crisp kid-voice definition. Hard cap keeps it tight.

origin.description: Optional etymology or memory hook, taught BEFORE 'why this matters' (e.g., 'Amend means to change — like mending a hole in a dress'). In Drive mode it is narrated, then the word is spoken slowly twice.

hard_to_pronounce.description: If true, the app can surface a 'practice this word' prompt with the slow audio.
